name: RH56DFX
summary: RH56DFX is INSPIRE ROBOTS' anthropomorphic five-finger hand for controlled gripping. The base model combines six degrees of freedom with 12 finger joints, RS485 communication and a listed mass of 540 g. Its official specification gives a 15 N maximum thumb gripping force and 10 N for the other fingers, alongside 0.5 N force resolution and ±0.2 mm repeatability. Left- and right-hand configurations are available in the catalogue. Wrist-equipped versions are listed separately with two additional wrist axes and a higher mass, rather than sharing every base-model specification.
